description: This file is a Makefile fragment from the OpenWrt/LEDE project, defining download methods, version variables, and integrity checks for package sources. It includes functions for handling various version control systems and download protocols, emphasizing download strategies and validation mechanisms.

methods.name: dl_method_git
methods.description: Determines download method based on URL pattern for git repositories, distinguishes between github_archive and generic git methods.

methods.name: dl_method
methods.description: Guesses the download method based on URL and protocol, supporting git, svn, cvs, hg, sftp, and others, returning a string identifier.

methods.name: dl_pack
methods.description: Selects appropriate compression tool for packaging downloaded source archives based on file extension.

methods.name: dl_tar_pack
methods.description: Creates a tarball from a directory, applies timestamp if specified, and compresses using the selected compression.

methods.name: check_download_integrity
methods.description: Checks the SHA256 hash of a downloaded file against the expected hash, enforcing re-download if mismatched.

methods.name: check_warn_nofix
methods.description: Outputs warning messages for download or hash issues, optionally fixing them if allowed.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/unknown
methods.description: Handles undefined or unsupported download methods by outputting an error message.

methods.name: DownloadMethod/default
methods.description: Defines the standard download process using a Perl script 'download.pl', with optional hash checking.
